disclaimer.title: Legal Disclaimer
disclaimer.content1: Agamiz Cinema does not host any files, it only links to 3rd party services and file hosters who host this content. Legal issues should be taken up with the file hosters and providers. Copyright takedown on Agamiz Cinema is pointless because the files are still available on the hosters' servers which we are not affiliated with.
disclaimer.content2: No user information is sent to the server — everything is running locally.
disclaimer.content3: We may update this disclaimer from time to time. We encourage you to review it periodically for any changes.
disclaimer.content4: If you enjoy a movie or series, please support the creators by subscribing to official streaming platforms or purchasing the content through legitimate channels.
